cohort: Laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 positive pregnant women with preeclampsia at a tertiary care hospital in India.
finding: Pregnant women with preeclampsia infected with SARS-CoV-2 experienced more severe illness, higher rates of intensive care admission, and increased maternal and neonatal morbidity.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 17 (42.50%) babies.
